benefits_health_001.answer: Yes. Plans: ISTA Trust Ambassador Care Plan, ISTA Trust Advantage HMO. Eligible group: Teachers and their dependents.

benefits_dental_006.answer: Yes. Plan: ISTA Insurance Trust dental plan. Eligibility: Each teacher and dependents. Employer contribution: Board pays annual premium except $.21 paid by teacher.
benefits_dental_006.evidence: Each teacher and his/her dependents shall be covered by a dental insurance plan with the ISTA Insurance Trust ... The Board shall pay the annual premium with the exception of twenty-one cents ($.21) which shall be paid by the teacher.
